clips.label: Arcing route
clips.note: Garden → railway → a library beside a face
clips.details:
Broad turn and approach, overlapping pullback and reversal, then a new diagonal approach. The face emerged without being explicitly requested. This excerpt starts at original source time 16 seconds, after the preserved opening.

Krea Turbo repaints its own warped previous painting. CFG1, three Euler intervals, unchanged prompt/noise/seed timing in the matched branches. Overlapping Lanczos motion paths combine pans, rolls, inward/outward zoom and regional twists. RIFE 4.25 scale 1 never feeds back. 24 fps delivery, three paintings per displayed second. All paintings retained; the seven frames after the final painting continue spatial warping.
